# BillableCalc

> BillableCalc (billablecalc.com) makes small, privacy-friendly tools: free calculators and guides for freelancers, and two browser extensions. Activity Cleaner bulk deletes your own LinkedIn posts, comments and likes. BillableCalc Timer tracks billable hours. No sign-up, and the extensions collect no data.

Made by Vitali Klachev (Burgas, Bulgaria). Contact: support@billablecalc.com

## Activity Cleaner for LinkedIn

A browser extension for Chrome, Firefox and Edge that bulk deletes your own LinkedIn activity: posts, reposts, comments and reactions (likes). LinkedIn has no "delete all" button. Activity Cleaner opens your activity pages and clicks delete for you, one item at a time, at a slow, human-like pace.

- Runs entirely in your browser. It never asks for your LinkedIn password and sends your LinkedIn data nowhere.
- A dry run counts everything first and deletes nothing.
- Free: up to 10 deletions a day. Pro: unlimited for $39/year, or a $9 pass for 7 days.
- Good for: cleaning up a profile before a job search, removing old opinions or likes, starting fresh after a career change.

- [Activity Cleaner home page](https://billablecalc.com/activity-cleaner.html): features, pricing, screenshots, FAQ
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cggmnmnchnbackhfknagljdeboidbgak)
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/activity-cleaner-linkedin/)
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/nnnlmaphpmillhkdhejoifahggaakpnd)
- [Privacy policy](https://billablecalc.com/privacy-cleaner.html)

## BillableCalc Timer

A Chrome extension for freelancers that reminds you to start the timer when you open a client's site, catches idle time, shows what you earn and turns hours into an invoice. No account. Free plan; Pro is $4/month or $29/year.

- [BillableCalc Timer home page](https://billablecalc.com/billable-hours-timer.html)
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/kcolochdcbfpdidechedpkdlobjmdned)
- [How to track billable hours without forgetting the timer](https://billablecalc.com/guides/how-to-track-billable-hours.html)
